articles.source: 星島日報 / Sing Tao Daily
articles.title: Japan Earthquake Shakes Major Chip and Car Factories in Kumamoto
articles.summary: A powerful earthquake struck Kumamoto Prefecture in Japan, causing widespread damage and forcing several large factories to temporarily shut down. Kumamoto is a key industrial region where global companies like TSMC, Sony, and Mitsubishi operate semiconductor and automobile plants. Tens of thousands of households lost access to electricity and clean water, while over 460 emergency shelters were set up to house around 10,000 displaced residents. Rescue teams continued searching for survivors, and authorities confirmed that five workers at a paper mill in Yatsushiro City had died. The disaster has raised international concerns about interruptions to the global supply of computer chips.

lv1: Which country did this earthquake happen in, and what kinds of factories had to stop working? (這次地震發生在哪個國家？哪些種類的工廠需要暫時停工？)
How many emergency shelters were opened to help people after the earthquake? (地震後共開設了多少個緊急避難所？)
lv2: Why might an earthquake in Kumamoto cause problems for people buying computers or cars in other countries? (為什麼熊本縣發生的地震會令其他國家的人在購買電腦或汽車時遇到問題？)
What do you think are the most important things a government should do right after a big earthquake to keep people safe? (你認為政府在大地震後應立即採取哪些最重要的措施來保護市民？)
lv3: Many of the world's most critical factories are located in earthquake-prone parts of Asia. Should companies spread their production across more countries to reduce this risk? What are the trade-offs of doing so? (全球許多重要工廠位於亞洲地震頻繁的地區。企業是否應將生產分散至更多國家以降低風險？這樣做有什麼利與弊？)

When a natural disaster in one country disrupts industries that the whole world depends on, who should be responsible for managing that risk — individual governments, multinational companies, or international organisations? (當一個國家發生自然災害，影響到全球依賴的工業時，誰應該負責管理這種風險——各國政府、跨國公司還是國際組織？)

articles.title: Hong Kong Lifts Economic Growth Forecast, Boosted by AI Trade and Spending
articles.summary: Hong Kong's government has raised its economic growth target for this year, now forecasting expansion of between 3.5% and 4.5%. Officials pointed to rising global trade in artificial intelligence-related products as a major factor behind the improvement. Consumer spending has also held up well, showing that households are continuing to buy goods and services despite global uncertainties. The upward revision reflects Hong Kong's growing importance as a technology and trade centre in Asia. Analysts will be monitoring whether the city can sustain this positive momentum through the remainder of 2026.

lv1: What is Hong Kong's new economic growth forecast for this year? (香港今年的最新經濟增長預測是多少？)
What type of products did the government say helped drive trade growth? (政府表示哪類產品有助推動貿易增長？)
lv2: Why might growth in the artificial intelligence industry help a trading city like Hong Kong earn more money? (為什麼人工智能行業的增長能幫助香港這個貿易城市賺取更多收入？)
What does it mean when economists say consumer spending is 'resilient', and why does this matter for a city's economy? (當經濟學家說消費具「韌性」，這是什麼意思？這對一個城市的經濟有何重要性？)
lv3: Hong Kong's economy is increasingly tied to AI and technology trade. Is it wise for a city to depend heavily on one fast-changing sector? What could go wrong, and how should the government prepare? (香港經濟愈來愈依賴人工智能和科技貿易。過度依賴一個快速變化的行業是否明智？可能出現什麼問題？政府應如何準備？)

Economic growth figures show how fast a country's economy is expanding, but some argue they don't reflect how fairly wealth is shared. Do you agree? What other indicators should we use to measure whether a society is doing well? (經濟增長數字顯示一個地方的經濟擴張速度，但有人認為它未能反映財富分配是否公平。你是否同意？我們還應用什麼指標衡量社會的整體狀況？)

articles.title: 啟德綠色集運系統截標　港鐵雲巴與載通智軌爭奪營辦權
articles.summary: 啟德綠色集體運輸系統招標已完成，共收到兩份標書，分別來自港鐵旗下的雲巴系統及載通的智軌電車方案。有議員指兩份標書數量比預期少，誰能成為香港首個新型綠色軌道交通營辦商備受關注。這項目標誌著香港在可持續城市交通發展上邁出重要一步，目標以更環保的方式連接啟德新發展區各地點，令居民更方便出行。社會各界正密切期待最終結果公布。

lv1: 啟德綠色集運系統招標共收到幾份標書？
港鐵和載通分別提交了什麼類型的交通系統方案？
lv2: 為什麼發展綠色集體運輸系統對啟德新區的居民和環境都有好處？
假如你是評審委員，你會考慮哪些因素來選出最合適的方案？
lv3: 香港引入新型綠色軌道交通，是否足以有效減少城市的碳排放？單靠改善交通系統能否應對氣候變化的挑戰？
公共交通系統應由政府機構還是私人企業主導營運？兩種模式各有什麼優點和潛在問題？

articles.title: 西九空鐵聯運獲批先導牌照　無人自動車接駁高鐵與九龍站
articles.summary: 西九龍高鐵站將推行「空鐵聯運」先導計劃，當局已批出先導牌照，讓無人自動車在高鐵站與九龍站之間行走，方便旅客轉乘不同交通工具。這是香港邁向智慧城市的重要一步，市民將可體驗更現代化的出行方式。不少人關注自動車的安全及實際運作情況。若計劃成功推行，香港有望成為區內首個結合高鐵、航空與自動駕駛技術的綜合交通樞紐。

lv1: 西九空鐵聯運的自動車將在哪兩個地點之間行駛？
當局為這項計劃批出了什麼類型的牌照？
lv2: 在公共交通系統中使用無人自動車，有哪些潛在好處和需要注意的風險？
為什麼把高鐵站與九龍站連接起來，對到港旅客和本地市民都很重要？
lv3: 香港引入自動駕駛公共交通系統，社會在接受這類新科技時，應如何平衡安全保障、私隱保護與就業影響等不同考量？
智慧城市的發展能否令所有市民平等受惠？哪些群體可能被忽略？政府應採取哪些措施確保科技發展的成果公平共享？
